BiblicalUsage: Tekoa is a town in the hill country of Judah, south of Bethlehem. In 2 Samuel 14:2, Joab sent to Tekoah. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tekoa matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
